| Danger                                                                                    | Where or in what situations does the hazard arise?                                                                                                                     | Preventative action                                                                                                                                                                           |
|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Risk of fire / smoke from defective electrical components or wrong electrical connections | If one of the electrical components is defect, for example due to a short circuit, or if the internal wiring is refitted incorrectly when servicing/repairing the oven | Never use electrical spare components which failed in a dedicated test or which bear visible damages Carefully refit electrical connections using the wiring diagrams provided in this manual |
